reviews.title: Great but
reviews.text: I like this app, pretty much identical to the previous OurHome app from years back which was my favorite organization app. The subscription model bugs me though, I would be more than willing to pay more up front for the premium features but only for lifetime access. Maybe that can be made as an option.

reviews.title: App Not Functioning
reviews.text:
This app would easily be a 5-star app if it worked as intended. I’m writing this review specifically for the developers because I want it to succeed, especially since it’s free.

Here are the issues I’m running into:
• I can’t assign tasks
• I can’t set permissions
• I can’t delete items from my lists

If these were fixed, the app would be excellent.

reviews.title: Cost!
reviews.text: Looked good so I downloaded it and then promptly deleted it because there is no mention of cost so you feel like you’re about to have the ball drop and not know how much it’s dropping for. List it as free or clearly state the cost.
